initial side, black-player tap that starts white, active player, handoff ordering, simultaneous or repeated taps, debounce, and touch ownership

portrait and landscape orientation, one rotated display, RTL layout, color independence, contrast, large touch targets, screen reader, and motor accessibility
screen wake, notification and sound permissions, background behavior, network absence, telemetry, filesystem access, and least privilege
new-game replacement, active-clock cancellation, result and history retention, preferences reset, uninstall, backups, and rollback
